decision: Gross Profit baseline uses exact GrossProfit only
scope_and_constraint: No universal fallback is permitted; SalesRevenueNet - CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold does not enter the baseline.

decision: FCF uses OCF - CapEx primary inputs
Negative primary CapEx is SIGN_EXCEPTION / unavailable
scope_and_constraint: Never apply absolute value or sign inversion.

decision: Conflicting values at the same latest eligible filing date are AMBIGUOUS / missing
scope_and_constraint: No arbitrary tie-break based on value, order, or final record.
US-GAAP facts may follow the same controls. IFRS facts require separately approved mapping and currency policy before use.
